is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles species including Anopheles gambiae s.l. and An. funestus s.l. in Benguela Province, Angola (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Targeted and genotyped Vgsc L1014F (L995F / kdr-West) and L1014S (L995S / kdr-East) mutations in An. gambiae complex members (Page 4, Kdr mutation detection; Page 10, Table 8).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 8 gives exact genotype counts (Leu/Leu, Leu/Phe, Phe/Phe, Phe/Ser) and sample sizes for An. coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s., An. arabiensis, and hybrids (Page 10, Table 8).

african_field_population.evidence: Field-collected adult mosquitoes and larvae reared to adults from Bela Vista, Cavaco River, and Alto Catumbela in Benguela Province, Angola, collected between February and June 2022 (Page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical field study reporting original entomological, bioassay, and molecular data (Page 1-4).

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections were conducted at specific sub-country sites in Benguela Province: Bela Vista (12°37′27.8ʺS, 13°22′23.4ʺE), Cavaco River (12°34′10.0ʺS, 13°25′11.5ʺE), and Alto Catumbela (12°56′15.3ʺS, 14°45′19.1ʺE) (Page 2, Study areas).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from 1 February to 30 June 2022 (Page 2, Study areas).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine primary entomological field survey conducted in 2022.

supplement.evidence: All required genotype counts, bioassay results, and site details are contained in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This primary study evaluated mosquito species composition, Plasmodium falciparum infection rates, blood-feeding habits, alpha-cypermethrin susceptibility, and target-site resistance marker frequencies (Vgsc L1014F and L1014S) in field populations of Anopheles coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s., and An. arabiensis from Benguela Province, Angola in 2022.
